free_tier.stated: Free: 100 GB storage, 10 GB per dataset upload, unlimited number of datasets and models. Pro ($29/seat/mo): 500 GB storage, 20 GB per upload. Enterprise: unlimited storage, 50 GB per upload.

egress.terms: Not metered — storage is the only billed dimension, and models/datasets download without a per-GB charge. No egress line on the pricing page.

tooling: The `ultralytics` Python package itself (YOLO) is the client: `model.train(data=..., project=...)` pushes datasets and weights to the platform; there is also a documented REST API and CLI. Extremely well maintained (the YOLO package is one of the most-installed ML packages).
chaining: Unlimited datasets × but 100 GB account total, so dataset count does not add bytes. The only multiplier is N accounts. Note the asymmetry: 'You can upload unlimited datasets across all plans ... There's no cap on the number of datasets themselves, only on total storage' — so the cap is total, cleanly.
limits_note: 100 GB total storage; individual file limits Images 50 MB, Videos 1 GB, dataset archives 10 GB on Free. That 50 MB image cap is the real killer for bulk image corpora, and the 1 GB video cap kills video datasets outright.
reliability_note: Stable commercial vendor with a huge user base. Data is tied to the training platform, so it is a walled garden rather than a general-purpose store — but downloads of your own artifacts are not paywalled.
